item.title: CKB Talk Daily Brief - 2026-08-08
item.description: ## 今日发生了什么 过去 24 小时里，Nervos Talk 最热闹的讨论集中在 Pocket Node for iOS 的提案上，多位开发者围绕 CCC 兼容签名器、dApp 浏览器和硬件成本展开了交锋 [S01, S02, S03, S04, S05]。与此同时，Fiber 互动教程正式上线、CKB-VM 技术解析文章发布，以及 Pocket Node v1.8.3 修复版本推出，让社区既有产品进展也有技术干货 [S08, S12, S13]。 ## 重点话题 **Pocket Node for iOS 讨论继续升温**：Jnr6 澄清了之前在 CCC 兼容性上的措辞错误 [S02]，而 phroi 表示作为 dApp 开发者，最感兴趣的是提案中的应用内 dApp 浏览器和 CCC 兼容签名器，并直言不认为新建一个无法与 Web DApp 交互的钱包有多大价值 [S03]。knmo 则质疑硬件成本的理由，认为 Android 版本之前已经获得过付款，且 iOS 版本瞄准三个 Apple 平台还包含 Android 版没有的 CCC signer [S04]。 **Pocket Node v1.8.3 发布**：Jnr6 发布了 Pocket Node 的新版本，主要修复了 Nervos DAO 和多重账户钱包相关的三个问题，其中一项是待提取的 DAO 存款此前只显示极小金额（实际只是网络费用）而不是完整金额 [S08]。 **Fiber 互动教程上线**：Sonny 发布公告称，Fiber...

item.title: CKB mBabel: Live Bilingual Captions for zh↔en Meetings (2 posts)
item.description: The problem CKB is a global community where Chinese and English are the two main languages, and spoken communication across them is hard. Written communication is fine (AI translation handles documents well), but live discussion suffers. For this pain point we need good caption-style translation: English speech shows Chinese text, Chinese speech shows English text. Priorities: translation accuracy first, then low latency. Runs on cloud APIs or a MacBook Pro M4 Pro (24GB). item.description: Pocket Node v1.8.3 is out: Nervos DAO and sub-account fixes v1.8.3 is now available. This release fixes three issues you, all around Nervos DAO and multi-account wallets. item.title: Deep Dive Into CKB-VM Instruction Decoder and Instruction Cache (1 posts)
item.description: If you have read the previous CKB articles, you probably already have a rough picture of the VM main loop: fetch, decode, execute, charge cycles, then move to the next instruction. In the earlier posts, we mainly focused on execution and cycle accounting. But as you can see, another stage is just as important: instruction fetch and decode. When people first read VM code, they usually focus on execution logic: how add is computed, how lw reads memory, and how ecall enters syscalls. But for a VM that must run a large number of on-chain scripts, execution logic is not the only cost. Before execution, the CPU still needs to translate raw bits in memory into internal instructions. item.title: From Reading the Docs to Running the Code: Fiber Interactive Tutorials Are Now Live (1 posts)
item.description: Hi everyone! Over the past few weeks, as we worked on Fiber’s developer experience, we noticed a recurring gap. The documentation explains the individual concepts and APIs, but turning them into a working application still means setting up an environment, connecting the pieces, and navigating several asynchronous states. We wanted to make that first experience more direct—and try something a little more interesting than another step-by-step guide. Thanks to fiber-js, a Fiber WASM Node can now run directly in the browser. That gave us the opportunity to put the explanation, real project code, and a live Testnet environment together in one place. The result is two new Interactive Tutorials...
